Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, learned counsel for the applicant.

2. Ms. Sweta Badola Dobhal and Mr. Prabhat Kandpal, learned Brief Holders for the State of Uttarakhand/respondent No.1.
3.

By means of the present C528 application, applicant has put to challenge the charge-sheet dated 28.05.2025, cognizance/summoning order dated 11.11.2025 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, in Criminal Case No.1639 of 2025 State Vs. Jishan Ahmad, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 IPC and under Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, as well as the entire proceedings of the aforesaid Criminal Case.
4.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
At the outset, it is contended by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant and respondent No.2 are husband and wife, and therefore, there are chances of some compromise between them to live together.
5. Only for the reason that there may by chance of some compromise between the parties, this Court is inclined to issue notice to respondent No.2 returnable within four weeks.
6. Steps to be taken within 03 days.
On which day, both the parties shall remain present before this Court.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) 03.12.2025 PN C528/2149/2025 on 3 December, 2025
